types.name: Hydroelectric dam
types.description: Hydro power plants of at least 100 MW; value is the plant's capacity. Power plants mapped in OpenStreetMap (as fetched in 2026), with each plant's tagged capacity; where OSM has none, the capacity of the same-fuel plant within 3 km in WRI's Global Power Plant Database (2021). Coverage depends on mappers: plants without a capacity in either source are left out, and rooftop solar is not mapped as plants.

types.name: Coal power plant
types.description: Coal-fired power plants of at least 300 MW; value is the plant's capacity. Power plants mapped in OpenStreetMap (as fetched in 2026), with each plant's tagged capacity; where OSM has none, the capacity of the same-fuel plant within 3 km in WRI's Global Power Plant Database (2021). Coverage depends on mappers: plants without a capacity in either source are left out, and rooftop solar is not mapped as plants.

types.name: Gas power plant
types.description: Gas-fired power plants (including LNG) of at least 300 MW; value is the plant's capacity. Coverage depends on mappers: plants without a capacity in either source are left out, and rooftop solar is not mapped as plants.

types.name: Oil power plant
types.description: Oil-fired power plants of at least 100 MW. Coverage depends on mappers: plants without a capacity in either source are left out, and rooftop solar is not mapped as plants.

types.name: Wind farms
types.description: Wind farms summed per hex, shown where a hex totals at least 30 MW. Near-shore farms snap to the nearest coastal hex. OpenStreetMap has many of Vietnam's wind farms without a capacity, so this layer shows well under the country's installed wind power. Power plants mapped in OpenStreetMap (as fetched in 2026), with each plant's tagged capacity; where OSM has none, the capacity of the same-fuel plant within 3 km in WRI's Global Power Plant Database (2021). Coverage depends on mappers: plants without a capacity in either source are left out, and rooftop solar is not mapped as plants.

types.name: Solar farms
types.description: Solar farms summed per hex, shown where a hex totals at least 40 MW (many of the farms built in 2019–2020 are just under 50 MW). Power plants mapped in OpenStreetMap (as fetched in 2026), with each plant's tagged capacity; where OSM has none, the capacity of the same-fuel plant within 3 km in WRI's Global Power Plant Database (2021). Coverage depends on mappers: plants without a capacity in either source are left out, and rooftop solar is not mapped as plants.
